mapper.insert: INSERT INTO properties ( property_id, agent_id, title, description, price, management_fee, layout, address, image_url, created_at ) VALUES ( properties_seq.NEXTVAL, #{agent_id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{management_fee}, #{layout}, #{address}, #{image_url}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE properties SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, management_fee = #{management_fee}, layout = #{layout}, address = #{address}, image_url = #{image_url} WHERE property_id = #{property_id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM properties
WHERE title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR address LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY property_id DESC
